subject.title: fix(external): guard Cleanup orphan sweep against a concurrent same-scope Acquire's claim

question: Should this timing-sensitive external-provider fix require a real-helper interleaving capture, or are the deterministic base-fails/head-passes tests sufficient for merge?
rationale: The implementation follows a merged provider pattern, but repository review policy treats real behavior proof as a merge gate for external PRs; only a maintainer can explicitly override that gate and accept the retained-routing tradeoff.

options.title: Require real-helper proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted terminal output or runtime logs show cleanup preserving a concurrently reclaimed claim and its routing through an actual external executable.

options.title: Accept deterministic proof
options.body: Apply an explicit proof override if the narrow timing window and merged Tart precedent make the focused regression tests sufficient.

recommendation.title: Require real-helper proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted terminal output or runtime logs show cleanup preserving a concurrently reclaimed claim and its routing through an actual external executable.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history covers destructive provider cleanup ownership and claim-mutation boundaries across several providers.
